description: Erection of a three storey rear extension at basement, ground and first floor levels with creation of a rear lightwell and front lightwell and front basement windows to allow for the internal reconfiguration of the existing six self contained dwellings (5 x studios and 1 x 1 bed unit) to create six dwellings (1 x 3 bed unit, 1 x 1 bed unit, 4 x studios).  (AMENDED)
decision_conditions:
<p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed 
strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any 
subsequent approval of details.
</p><p> REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in 
full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p>

<p>The flat roof area of the two storey extension shall not be used for 
any purpose other than as a means of escape in emergency or for maintenance 
of the building. In particular the roof shall not be used as a roof terrace, area 
for planting, balcony or any other amenity area.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area 
generally.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration 
of three years beginning with the date of this permission
</p><p> REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country 
Planning Act 1990 as amended.</p>

<p>The side facing windows 
at 1st floor level of the two storey extension must be made from obscure glazing and fixed shut up to a 
height of 1.7m when measured internally. 
Full details of these windows.&nbsp; These details must be&nbsp; retained in perpetuity. </p><p>
REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory 
and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area and to 
protect the amenity of adjacent occupiers.</p>

<p>Prior to commencement of works, full details, with samples, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces 
of the buildings, including scaled drawing of&nbsp; fenestration showing 12-14mm glazing thickness&nbsp;shall be submitted to and approved by the 
Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  
The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with 
the details thus approved.</p><p> REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory 
and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area</p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Prior to the commencement of the development, details of the green roof for the flat roof of the two storey extension including a 1:20 section drawing through&nbsp;the substrate, and details of a maintenance plan must be submitted to the local planning authority for review and approval.</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: In the interests of biodiversity.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, raingarden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: In order to mitigate risk of flooding and be in accordance with </span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">policy LP53 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), policy SI 12 of the London Plan (2021)</span></p>

<p>The side facing windows at the first floor level for flat 6 shall be obscured glazed and fixed shut below 1.7m of the internal floor height.&nbsp; This must not be altered for the life of this development.</p><p>

REASON: To protect neighbour amenity</p>

<div><font face="Arial" size="2">No&nbsp;</font><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">development shall commence, other than works of demolition, until a report (including intrusive investigation/trial pit and monitoring where necessary) demonstrating that the basement development will not increase the potential for groundwater&nbsp;</span><span class="il" style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">flooding</span><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">&nbsp;to itself or to the surrounding area during and post-construction has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. Where groundwater is identified as a potential risk, details of appropriate controls including&nbsp;</span><span class="il" style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">flood</span><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;">&nbsp;resilience and/or resistance measures shall be submitted to the LPA for approval and the approved measures incorporated before the basement is occupied. The basement shall be constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with BS 8102:2022 Protection of below ground structures against water ingress - code of practice.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial; font-size: small;"><br></span></div><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-80362be0-7fff-3bff-94a2-270ddcc909f3"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: In order to mitigate risk of flooding and be in accordance with </span></span><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">policy LP53 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), policy SI 12 of the London Plan (2021)</span></p>

<div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Prior to the commencement of development:</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">i) a preliminary risk assessment, which identifies all previous uses, potential&nbsp;<span class="il">contaminants</span>&nbsp;associated with those uses (including asbestos, landfill gas, vapours, and groundwater&nbsp;<span class="il">contaminants</span>); a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways, and receptors; and potentially unacceptable risks arising from&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;at the site&nbsp;shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority; and&nbsp;</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br>ii) following the preliminary risk assessment,&nbsp; the applicant will be expected to either provide evidence to show that there is no risk from land&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;or otherwise embark on further investigation of potential land&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;in line with LCRM guidance, and this must be submitted to and approved by the LPA in writing prior to the commencement of any development at the site.&nbsp;</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">If additional significant&nbsp;<span class="il">contamination</span>&nbsp;is found at any time when carrying out the approved development, it must immediately be reported in writing to the LPA.</div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></div><div style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">REASON: To ensure that any contamination sources at the site have been adequately dealt with in line with the legislation.&nbsp;</div>
